briefdescription.para: Initialize global cache for prepared statements.

detaileddescription.para: Called once during database setup (in sql_init()).

briefdescription.para: Store statistics concerning cache (current size and number of statements in it) into info handler .
Remove statement entry from cache: remove from LRU list and account cache size changes, then release occupied memory.

detaileddescription.para: At the moment of calling this function, entry is already removed from hash.

briefdescription.para: Allocate new cache entry containing given prepared statement.

detaileddescription.para: Add it to the LRU cache list. Account cache size enlargement.

briefdescription.para: Return true if used memory (accounting new entry) for SQL prepared statement cache does not exceed the limit.
Erase session local hash: unref statements belong to this session and deallocate hash itself.

detaileddescription.para: is assumed to be member of struct session .

briefdescription.para: Add entry corresponding to prepared statement with given ID to session-local hash and increase its ref counter.

detaileddescription.para: is assumed to be member of struct session .

briefdescription.para: Prepared statement ID is supposed to be hash value of the original SQL query string.
Unref prepared statement entry in global holder.
Save prepared statement to the prepared statement cache.

detaileddescription.para: Account cache size change. If the cache is full (i.e. memory quota is exceeded) diag error is raised. In case of success return id of prepared statement via output parameter .
In case of search fails it returns NULL.
